brief: Demo example 6. Square Hole's own joke, a square peg in a round hole: 69 pegs, hidden until drawn, with 3 special Round Pegs. Meant to be priced in FIT so the buyers' side burns FIT. Opens 5 minutes after creation.
shows: burn FIT on the buyers' side
new collection, hidden art with placeholders
collection page: a banner and 2 teasers
opens 5 min after creation: the launch flow's preset (the draft says Now)
differences: Priced in FIT ("q": FIT, "qStream": "BURN_Q") needs FIT on the curated list, once FIT trades (ref. slice S12). Until then it is priced in ETH and the buyers' side uses "ALL_TO_FIT" (Burn FIT), which still burns FIT.
An own hidden picture (a peg) waits for an SVG upload in the launch flow; until then tickets show its neutral picture ("hiddenSvg": "FROM_LAUNCH_FLOW").
5 minutes after creation is a launch-flow choice ("5 min", turned into a time at Create); a draft holds a UTC time or 0, so it says Now ("openAt": 0).

spec.description: Demo: 69 square pegs that still fit the square hole. A few are round.
